question: Which is the smallest three-digit number which when increased by 5 becomes divisible by both 2 and 3?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Among the given options, 

The smallest three-digit number which when increased by 5 becomes divisible by both 2 and 3 will be 

⇒ 108 - 3 = 103

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** Actual smallest three-digit number divisible by both 2 and 3 is 102
